Fixed in place. The rejection was a diff-pairing artifact: my new test sat mid-file (right before `200 body error throws MagicSeoError`), and the validator's diff paired that 63-line insertion as a remove+re-add, flagging the base `await assert.rejects(` line as removed — even though it appears exactly 2 times in both base and current file and git's diff never touched it. I moved the new test to the end of `tests/magicseo/client.test.ts` (content unchanged), so that part of the diff is purely additive. Verified: the diff's only removed lines are the `import type { MutationEntry }` line and the one-line `catalogItems` READS row — both rewritten in place immediately after; `await assert.rejects(` now appears in no removed line under both default and histogram diff.

## Changed paths

- `lib/magicseo/client.ts` — unchanged from the previous attempt: `catalogItems()` pages `?offset=N&limit=100` (N = 0, 100, …) while distinct collected projects < `total`, at most 20 pages, pages merged by item id without duplicate project ids; return shape `{ items, total }` kept; still a read (no `mutate`, `onMutation` never fires).
- `tests/magicseo/client.test.ts` — new two-page test relocated to EOF (L370-432); catalogItems READS row asserts `offset=0&limit=100` (L62-68) via the now-live `urlIncludes` check (L197-199).

## Verification (re-run after the move)

| Command | Result |
|---|---|
| `node /tmp/magicseo/check-paging.mjs` | exit 0 — `requests: …?offset=0&limit=100 \| …?offset=100&limit=100 projects: 130` |
| `node --test tests/magicseo/client.test.ts` | 8 pass, 0 fail |
| `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` | exit 0 |
| `node --test tests/magicseo/client.test.ts tests/magicseo/lifecycle.test.ts` | 13 pass, 0 fail (regression) |

```plan-fact
[
  {"item":1,"status":"done","evidence":["lib/magicseo/client.ts:152-170","cmd:node /tmp/magicseo/check-paging.mjs"]},
  {"item":2,"status":"done","evidence":["tests/magicseo/client.test.ts:370-432","tests/magicseo/client.test.ts:62-68","cmd:node --test tests/magicseo/client.test.ts"]},
  {"item":3,"status":"done","evidence":["lib/magicseo/client.ts:169","cmd:npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json"]}
]
```

APPROACH: Diagnosed the rejection as a diff-positioning artifact (pattern count 2→2, no hunk removed the line) rather than a real deletion; fixed minimally by relocating the new test to EOF so the insertion is unambiguous under any diff algorithm, then re-ran every verification plus the lifecycle regression.

LESSON: Large mid-file insertions can make a validator's diff pair unrelated base lines as "removed" even when git's diff is clean — append new self-contained tests at end-of-file so the diff is purely additive and load-bearing base lines never appear in a removed hunk.
